Physics
(magazine)
Physics
is an
open-access
online publication containing commentaries on the best of the
peer-reviewed
research published in the journals of the
American Physical Society
. The
editor-in-chief
of
Physics
is Matteo Rini.
[
1
]
It highlights papers in
Physical Review Letters
and the
Physical Review
family of journals.
[
1
]
[
2
]
The magazine was established in 2008.
[
3
]
Features
Physics
contains three types of commentaries on research papers: journalistic articles ("Focus"), in depth pieces written by active researchers ("Viewpoints"), and short summaries of a research paper ("Synopsis") written by editorial staff.
[
1
]
Readers get free access to the underlying research papers on which the commentaries are based.
